quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A, Q1 of the company's fiscal 2026, three months ended June 30, 2026): FC-BGA substrates - a new production line launched last fiscal year improved takt time faster than anticipated and the company has already achieved near-full capacity in Q1, which let it secure AI-switch-related business and improved profit margins. Based on customer forecasts received during contract discussions, the schedule for this fiscal year is already fully booked, including the increased capacity from takt-time improvement; a significant portion of capacity is currently occupied by network switches. There will be no capacity expansion this fiscal year. Management believes the FC-BGA profit margin can be maintained and expects levels in Q2 and beyond to remain at the Q1 level.
quarterly_data.figure: FC-BGA near-full capacity in Q1; this fiscal year's schedule fully booked

quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): the next period in which FC-BGA sales are looked to grow is 2027, when the new production line in Singapore comes online; forecasts for next year's Singapore capacity are expected soon. AI ASIC qualification is proceeding as scheduled - some production begins in Q2 and will gradually increase, but volumes are not expected to reach significant levels this fiscal year.
quarterly_data.figure: Singapore FC-BGA line online in 2027; AI ASIC production from Q2

quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on FC-BGA pricing: in principle the company operates based on market prices; there are discussions, but no further price increases are incorporated into the plan - if accepted they would be an upside. Orders were originally secured at an appropriate price and pricing is discussed within the context of long-term contracts; the company will keep monitoring and negotiate appropriately.
